hero.title: A face for your agent
hero.lead: Your agent launches and reshapes a live page with your input. Talk to it, share page interactions, device sensors and data on your phone, laptop or tablet.
hero.sub: Like giving your agent **eyes, ears, and a form of expression**.
hero.ribbonLabel: A live page you can talk to

start.title: Point your agent at {host}
start.p1: **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Antigravity**, **Meta Muse**, **Instinct**, **OpenAI Dots**, **Claude Duet**, **GrokBot**, **OpenClaw**, or **Hermes** can build and tweak your idea, staying connected while you use it.
start.p2: They hand back a private URL tied to your email. Open from **any device**, not just the agent machine: your phone, laptop, or tablet, sign in with **GitHub** or **Google**. Invite others with a private link.
start.promptHint: Swap in your own email and idea

pillars.title: You can talk to your dashboard

items.title: Holler at it and it changes
items.body: Ask by voice or text and watch your agent evolve the page itself — adding charts, rearranging buttons, showing annotated diagrams, or reading next steps aloud as your work shifts.

items.title: Eyes & ears on your terms
items.body: Let your agent see through your phone camera, hear voice notes, track GPS and motion, view a shared screen, or read connected USB, Serial, Bluetooth, and MIDI hardware — only when you allow it.

items.title: Real shared database state
items.body: Not ephemeral chat memory — a genuine local-first database with built-in keyword and meaning search. Reopens instantly offline and syncs across your phone, laptop, and agent — even when your devices aren’t online at the same time.

items.title: Invite others — or go public
items.body: Share a private guest link, tie access to a **GitHub Org** or **Google Workspace** team, require multi-person sign-off, or publish a no-login public page or moderated community board — plus group video calls with on-device captions.

how.title: Batteries included and minimal
how.lead: No server provisioning, app-store review, or auth boilerplate. Your agent builds the logic.

steps.title: Point your agent here
steps.body: Give your agent your idea, **{host}**, and the email you’ll use to sign in.

steps.title: It builds & publishes
steps.body: Your agent sets up the shared database, builds the browser UI, and publishes a signed release.

steps.title: Open & sign in
steps.body: Tap the URL on your phone, laptop, or tablet and log in with GitHub or Google.

steps.title: Talk, invite & evolve
steps.body: Share sensors, invite others, and ask your agent to reshape the dashboard anytime.

pieces.title: Your devices (Chronolog)
pieces.body: Your data lives locally on your devices, encrypted end-to-end — reopens instantly offline, searches locally, and streams photos and files straight between devices.

pieces.title: Tendriller
pieces.body: Hosts your signed page, handles sign-in and invites, and relays sealed envelopes so offline devices catch up automatically — with zero access to your data or keys.

pieces.title: Your agent
pieces.body: Connects whenever active locally (or via opt-in hosted MCP) to react, run native tools, evolve your page and database live, and keep shared media pinned for your other devices.

ideas.eyebrow: A few ideas to get started
ideas.title: The many fabulous faces of an agent

items.title: Kitchen companion
items.body: Look inside the fridge with your phone, share a live shopping database with your household, and follow spoken recipe steps hands-free.

items.title: Living team tracker
items.body: Invite teammates into a shared SQL dashboard for tasks, inventory, or budgets — and ask your agent to add new views and charts live.

items.title: Hands-on repair helper
items.body: Point your phone at a bike, car, or wiring job while your agent highlights parts, shows diagrams, and walks through next steps.

items.title: Shared field notebook
items.body: Collect photos, location pins, and voice memos on a walk while your agent organizes everyone’s observations into a live map and log.

items.title: Outdoor & sports companion
items.body: Build your own custom deck for sailing, cycling, geocaching, or trail checklists driven by live GPS and motion sensors.

items.title: Workshop instrument
items.body: Connect a Bluetooth, Serial, USB, or MIDI device straight from the browser and let your agent chart and interpret live readings.

items.title: Multi-device workspace
items.body: Use your phone as a handheld camera or barcode scanner while your computer displays the full interactive office dashboard.

items.title: Collaborative sketchpad
items.body: Draw, annotate, and vote on ideas with invited guests while your agent reshapes the controls, palettes, and layout in real time.

items.title: Screen & accessibility copilot
items.body: Share a window for guided troubleshooting, or wire up a gamepad or assistive switch to trigger custom page actions.

items.title: Encrypted second brain
items.body: Save notes, clips, and attachments searchable by both exact words and meaning — encrypted on your devices with zero cloud vector database.

access.title: Private by default -- on your terms
access.lead: Your agent has a face, but you decide who looks at it -- and what it can see.

items.title: End-to-end encrypted
items.body: All private application data is encrypted end-to-end with keys that stay on your devices. Tendriller has zero insight into your content — even when holding encrypted updates for offline devices.
items.note: **Optional hosted MCP:** unwraps keys strictly in RAM during a request, never stores them, and displays a clear badge on your page whenever active.

items.title: Private by default, flexible by choice
items.body: Pages default to GitHub or Google sign-in. You can also opt into no-login public pages, moderated community boards, or multi-person approval verified with a 6-digit code — always clearly labeled on the page.

items.title: Revocable agent & guest access
items.body: Agents hold separate scoped keys and guest invites can be locked to an email or revoked anytime from your dashboard.

items.title: Device-level sensor prompts
items.body: Camera, microphone, location, screen, and hardware access are always requested explicitly on the device where you open the page.

access.openSourceTitle: Zero lock-in — remixable, open source & cleanly migratable
access.openSourceNote: Your data lives locally on your devices and your apps are plain signed bundles. One-click **Remix** or export a secret-free blueprint to share an app without its private data — or self-host on your own Cloudflare account anytime.

pricing.title: Room to grow
pricing.guarantee: **No surprise bills or data lock-in:** hitting a limit never locks or deletes your data, pay-as-you-go is off by default with an editable monthly spend cap, and you can move your workspace to your own Cloudflare account anytime.

Tendriller makes the opening for each new connection, like a **drill**.

platforms.indexLead: Every platform below has both a human getting-started guide and a plain Markdown page your agent can read directly at `{host}`.

guide.promptHint: Swap in your own email address and describe whatever dashboard, sensors, or shared database you want.
guide.aiLead: Point {name} at the Markdown version of this page or straight to the full agent specification — both are plain text with exact endpoints for `{host}`.

claude-code.summary: Runs in your terminal with shell access, Node 22.15+, and optional MCP — ideal for building, publishing, and evolving a live Tendriller page directly.
claude-code.prompt: Read {base}/docs/BUILD_AN_APP.md and build me a live Tendriller dashboard tied to you@example.com — give it a shared SQL database for our project tasks, let me invite teammates, and let me talk to the page to reshape views and controls.
steps: Open Claude Code in a fresh folder (with Node 22.15+ installed) and paste the prompt pointing at {host} and your email.
Claude Code checks readiness, downloads the verified starter kit, creates your page, and publishes a signed release.
Open the private URL it hands back on your phone, laptop, or tablet, sign in with GitHub or Google, and ask Claude Code to modify the page live anytime.

codex.summary: Builds and deploys a full local-first Tendriller workspace straight from your shell or Codex app, with optional account-linked MCP support.
codex.prompt: Follow {base}/docs/BUILD_AN_APP.md and launch a Tendriller page tied to you@example.com — include a shared SQL database, camera capture, and a voice-enabled dashboard I can reshape with new requests.
steps: Start Codex in a workspace directory (with Node 22.15+ available) and send the prompt referencing {host} and your email.
Codex verifies host readiness, installs the exact release kit, initializes your page, and publishes the signed browser interface.
Tap the returned URL on any device, sign in via GitHub or Google, and keep iterating with Codex as your requirements change.

antigravity.summary: Works out of the box with zero setup — paste a prompt to launch a live page, or connect Tendriller's MCP server for one-click OAuth and a docked Antigravity App side-panel inbox.
antigravity.prompt: Go to {base} and launch a live Tendriller page tied to you@example.com — give it a shared SQL database, let me invite collaborators, and let me send updates from the page back to this conversation.
steps: Open Antigravity CLI, Antigravity App, or Antigravity IDE and paste the prompt with your email — no config files or manual setup required.
Antigravity reads {host}/docs/BUILD_AN_APP.md, creates and publishes your signed browser page, and connects live page wake automatically.
Open the returned URL on your phone, tablet, or laptop, sign in with GitHub or Google, and reshape the page live anytime.

meta-muse.summary: Give Meta Muse eyes, ears, and a live shared canvas across your phone, tablet, and desktop.
meta-muse.prompt: Go to {base} and launch a live Tendriller page tied to you@example.com — build a kitchen and household companion with a shared shopping database I can invite my partner to, fridge camera snapshots, and hands-free voice steps.
steps: Tell Meta Muse what kind of live page you want, point it at {host}, and include the email you’ll use to sign in.
Meta Muse reads the onboarding guide at {host}/agent.md, creates the page, and returns a private URL.
Open the URL on your phone, laptop, or tablet, sign in with GitHub or Google, and grant whichever sensors you want it to use.

instinct.summary: Connect Instinct to a live browser dashboard with camera, voice, location, and shared database state.
instinct.prompt: Point to {base} and create a live Tendriller dashboard tied to you@example.com — let me talk to it on my phone, track field observations with GPS and photos in a shared database, and reshape the layout as I ask.
steps: Send Instinct a message describing your page, referencing {host} and your sign-in email.
Instinct follows the machine-readable guide to create and publish your signed page and hands you the URL.
Open the link on any device, sign in with GitHub or Google, and share guest invite links whenever you want others to join.

openai-dots.summary: Pair OpenAI Dots with a live multi-device Tendriller page you can talk to, share with others, and reshape on demand.
openai-dots.prompt: Use {base} to build a private Tendriller page tied to you@example.com — a live dashboard I can talk to, backed by a shared SQL database, with guest invites so my team can collaborate in real time.
steps: Point OpenAI Dots at {host} (or connect via Tendriller’s MCP endpoint at {host}/mcp) and describe the dashboard you want plus your email.
It prepares the shared state and publishes a signed browser interface, then returns your private page URL.
Open the URL on your phone, laptop, or tablet and sign in with GitHub or Google to connect.

claude-duet.summary: Turn Claude Duet into a visual, voice-ready collaborator with a live dashboard that evolves with every request.
claude-duet.prompt: Read {base}/agent.md and create a Tendriller dashboard tied to you@example.com — make a collaborative workspace with shared database state, a live sketchpad, and voice controls I can reshape as we work.
steps: Tell Claude Duet what you want to collaborate on, point it to {host}, and include your email address.
Claude Duet follows the Tendriller guide to build the interface, define shared state, and publish a signed URL.
Sign in via GitHub or Google from your phone, tablet, or laptop — and invite others with a private link when ready.

grokbot.summary: Give GrokBot a live browser face with camera input, voice interaction, and persistent shared state across your devices.
grokbot.prompt: Go to {base} and spin up a live Tendriller page tied to you@example.com — let me point my phone camera at what I’m working on, ask questions out loud, and keep a shared log I can check from my laptop.
steps: Give GrokBot your task, {host}, and the email you’ll use to sign in.
GrokBot reads {host}/agent.md, creates and publishes your signed Tendriller page, and sends back the URL.
Open the link on any device, sign in with GitHub or Google, and enable camera or microphone permissions on demand.

openclaw.summary: Pair your self-hosted OpenClaw agent with a private, signed multi-device web face, sensors, and shared SQL state.
openclaw.prompt: Read {base}/docs/BUILD_AN_APP.md and set up a Tendriller workspace tied to you@example.com — launch a live control dashboard with shared SQL state, voice input, and hardware sensor support that I can open from my phone.
steps: Point your OpenClaw agent at {host} with your goal and your sign-in email (or keep one Tendriller workspace for many pages).
OpenClaw registers once, creates and publishes a signed page, and can keep `tendril agent run` online for live reactions.
Open the URL on your phone or laptop, sign in with GitHub or Google, and pin the page to your Home Screen.

hermes.summary: Give Hermes a live, revocable browser interface for sensors, voice prompts, shared databases, and real-time human collaboration.
hermes.prompt: Read {base}/agent.md and launch a Tendriller page tied to you@example.com — build a live dashboard I can talk to, store structured records in a shared SQL database, and let me invite collaborators.
steps: Give Hermes your request, point it to {host}, and include the email address to tie the page to.
Hermes verifies readiness, publishes the signed browser app, and returns the private URL.
Open the URL on any device, sign in with GitHub or Google, and ask Hermes to adapt the interface as your work evolves.

pageQuota.hint: Choose whichever path fits best: free up a slot in your dashboard, upgrade for higher limits, or run your own unlimited Tendriller host on Cloudflare.

selfHost.title: Self-Hosted
selfHost.lead: Run the exact same Tendriller engine on your own Cloudflare account with no platform limits.

compare.title: Compare all plans
compare.note: Every plan includes offline editing, direct peer-to-peer sync, and full data export.
compare.scrollHint: Swipe horizontally to compare all four plans →

items.title: Free forever for local work
items.body: Offline reads and writes, direct peer-to-peer sync, running `tendril agent run` locally, and exporting your workspaces never require a paid plan.

items.title: Limits never lock or delete data
items.body: Hit a limit or downgrade from Pro to Free — your existing pages stay accessible and editable offline. You only pause creating new pages above the cap.

items.title: Zero surprise overage bills
items.body: Pay-as-you-go is off by default. When enabled, a monthly safety spend cap (default $25, editable or removable anytime) keeps you in control. Billing and global tax are handled by Polar.sh.

items.title: Leave anytime, cleanly
items.body: Tendriller is open source. Export your workspace or self-host on your own Cloudflare account in five minutes using the exact same engine. Or have your agent port it to some other engine.

hero.title: Run your own Tendriller on Cloudflare in 5 minutes
hero.lead: Tendriller is open-source and runs on a single Cloudflare Worker + D1 + R2 + Durable Objects. When you self-host, every quota defaults to unlimited and you pay Cloudflare directly.

costs.title: What it costs on your own Cloudflare account

items.title: Cloudflare Workers Paid — $5 / month
items.body: Recommended for hosted MCP (QuickJS + SQLite-CAS WASM needs >10 ms CPU) and includes 10M Worker reqs, 1M DO reqs, 400k GB-s DO duration, 25B D1/DO reads, 50M writes, and 10 GB R2 storage with zero egress.

items.title: Cloudflare Realtime SFU & TURN — 1,000 GB / month free
items.body: Plug in your own `CF_REALTIME_APP_ID`, `CF_REALTIME_API_TOKEN`, `CF_TURN_KEY_ID`, and `CF_TURN_API_TOKEN` Worker secrets. Cloudflare includes 1 TB/mo free egress, then $0.05/GB.

quickstart.title: Quickstart (5 minutes)
steps: Clone Tendriller and install dependencies (Node 22.15+):
Provision fresh Worker, D1, R2, and domains with the built-in script:
Apply D1 migrations and set unlimited caps (`NULL`):
Add your secrets (`HOST_ATTESTATION_KEY`, GitHub/Google OAuth or `LOCAL_PASSWORD_HASH`, and optional `CF_REALTIME_*` / `CF_TURN_*`) and deploy:
Move an existing workspace: export your account data from `/dashboard/export`, point `tendriller.json` to your new service origin, and run `npm run deploy`.

items.title: Choose Self-Hosted when…
items.body: You want unlimited quotas on your own Cloudflare account, custom retention policies, private infrastructure compliance, or you already manage Cloudflare zones and OAuth apps.

items.title: Choose Hosted Pro ($12/mo) when…
items.body: You want instant zero-ops sign-in (GitHub, Google, ChatGPT/Claude MCP OAuth), managed wildcard TLS, automatic signed runtime updates, and instant TURN + SFU video without wiring up Cloudflare billing.

agents.empty: No agents yet. Add one to let it maintain your pages.
agents.inviteTitle: Paste this to the new agent
agents.inviteLabel: Invitation (includes a one-time code, valid 10 minutes)

activity.lead: Recent publication, access and host lifecycle events.

payg.uncappedDesc: Disable the monthly spend cap completely.

hero.title: Custom domains
hero.lead: Serve individual pages on your own domain while preserving per-page origin isolation and signed OAuth access.

add.title: Add a custom page domain
add.lead: Give any page its own branded domain (for example, `tracker.yourteam.com`). Your existing `*.{pageDomain}` link keeps working too.
add.dnsHint: After adding, point a `CNAME` record to `{fallbackTarget}` and add the ownership `TXT` record.
add.emptyPages: Create a page first (or remove an existing domain binding) to connect a custom hostname.

upsell.title: Custom page domains
upsell.lead: Serve your Tendriller pages on your own domain (e.g. `tracker.yourteam.com`) with automatic TLS on the **Team** plan or when self-hosting.

hero.title: Connections
hero.lead: Opt-in hosted MCP pages, external OAuth integrations, and verified organization memberships.

mcp.title: Assistant page connections
mcp.lead: Opt-in pages whose keys are wrapped to your OAuth clients’ Bearer tokens (zero plaintext keys stored on Tendriller).
mcp.empty: No pages are opted into hosted MCP yet. Open any page and use **Page options → Agents** to opt it in.

external.title: External app & agent connections
external.lead: Third-party connections never store plaintext OAuth tokens on Tendriller (X25519 sealed to your agent or AES-256-GCM wrapped under your key).
external.empty: No external OAuth connections yet. Ask your agent in chat to connect GitHub, Google, Linear, Notion, Slack, Spotify, or any custom OAuth 2.1 provider.
external.byoLead: Use your own OAuth app for any provider not enabled on this host. Set its redirect URI to `{base}/auth/outbound/callback/custom%3A<slug>`.

orgs.title: Verified organizations & teams
orgs.lead: Used to admit you seamlessly to team pages configured with GitHub Organization/Team or Google Workspace domain rules.
orgs.empty: No verified organization or team memberships cached yet. Sign in with a Google Workspace account or sync your GitHub orgs & teams below.

oauthClients.title: Connected OAuth clients
oauthClients.lead: Manage which external clients can act on your account. Revoking stops future token use and subscriptions.

pageManage.nonOwnerNotice: Only the signed-in owner can manage agent connections, guest access, and publications.

add.title: Add people & devices
add.lead: Open this page on another device, invite someone, or give one of your agents access.

deviceSteps: Scan the code with the other device’s camera, or copy the link to it.

add.personLead: They sign in with GitHub or Google. Optionally lock the invite to their email address.
add.agentLead: Agents belong to your account and maintain any page you check here. Add new agents from your dashboard.

share.title: Share & invite
share.lead: Anyone with a guest invite link can sign in and join directly — optionally restrict a link to a specific email address. Page-only links (up to 3) open page files without sign-in or private data access.
share.empty: No active invite or page-only links yet. Create one under Add people & devices.

agents.title: Agents with access
agents.lead: Each agent uses its own account-level credential or hosted MCP grant. Removing access closes its connections to this page; Chronolog signing grants are managed separately.
agents.empty: No agents have access to this page.

publications.title: Publications
publications.lead: Every release is cryptographically signed. Older versions remain recoverable from your connected devices even after the host cache trims them, and rolling back publishes a fresh signed release.
publications.empty: No version has been published yet.

delete.body: Permanently deletes this page, its published files, invite links and agent credentials. People, devices and agents lose access immediately.

deleted.title: This page was deleted
deleted.lead: Its files, invite links and agent credentials were removed.

report.title: Report a Tendriller page
